adds.title: X-Men '97#17
adds.text: After the Acolytes abduct Graydon, Beast goes to the Savage Land with the X-Men to rescue him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The bigot Beast helps rescue from the Acolytes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Helps rescue Graydon from the Acolytes.
adds.evidence: Strange Land, Savage Heart (S2E7, running #17): Nightcrawler, Rogue, Beast, Bishop and Polaris go to the Acolytes' Savage Land base to free the abducted Creed ('the man we're rescuin''); Beast is on the rescue team and at the trial. No direct one-on-one exchange found, so medium.

adds.title: X-Men '97#9
adds.text: Morph fights Bastion's army of Sentinels with the X-Men's Gold Team in the Galapagos Islands.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's army Morph fights in the Galapagos.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Bastion's Sentinels in the Galapagos.
adds.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2 (S1E9): the Gold Team battles Bastion-controlled Sentinels at his Galapagos volcano base; transcript has Bastion speaking through the Sentinels followed by 'Morph smash!'.

adds.title: X-Men '97#1
adds.text: Gyrich gets word to Trask from prison that the X-Men are coming for him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Warns Trask from prison that the X-Men are coming.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Sentinel maker Gyrich warns from prison.
adds.evidence: To Me, My X-Men (S1E1): in the Sahara Trask tells the X-Men 'Gyrich warned me you were coming. Even in prison, he has friends...'.

adds.title: X-Men '97#3
adds.text: Morph, once Sinister's puppet, offers to show Scott where Sinister is, and Scott lets him lead the strike to save Nathan.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Scott to Sinister's lair to save Nathan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Morph guides to Sinister's lair.
adds.evidence: Fire Made Flesh (S1E3): Morph says 'I can show you where he is'; Scott answers 'Are you sure, Morph?... Fine. Lead the way.' Wikipedia: Morph leads the X-Men to Sinister's lab where Nathan is held.

adds.title: X-Men '97#8
adds.text: When Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Xavier's school, Wolverine fights them off with his claws.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Logan at the school.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights the Prime Sentinels at Xavier's school.
adds.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (S1E8): Prime Sentinels activate and attack Xavier's school (Wikipedia); transcript has a Prime Sentinel taunting and Logan's 'Lady, I got six reasons why', with Nightcrawler and Rogue in the fight.

adds.title: X-Men '97#8
adds.text: The da Costas' butler turns out to be one of Bastion's Prime Sentinels and attacks Jubilee and Roberto.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bastion's Prime Sentinels attack Jubilee and Roberto.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A young X-Man the Prime Sentinels attack.
adds.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1 (S1E8): at Roberto's family home the butler Ford activates ('Surrender, mutants'); Jubilee: 'Did your butler just turn into a Sentinel zombie? I am totally done with malls.'

adds.title: X-Men '97#13
adds.text: Bishop tracks Nur down in ancient Egypt and fights him to get the stranded X-Men back to their own time.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bishop fights him in ancient Egypt.
adds.evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part 1 (S2E3, running #13): Bishop arrives: 'En Sabah Nur. You thought you could hide. But I found you', knocks him down ('before he comes to'); Part 2 opens with Magneto telling Bishop to stay his hand. Wikipedia: Bishop went to 3000 B.C. to rescue the X-Men.

adds.title: X-Men '97#14
adds.text: Beast recognizes Nur's lost temple as Ship, and once Nur becomes Apocalypse, Beast uses pieces of Ship to send the X-Men home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Becomes Apocalypse at the temple Beast recognizes as Ship.
adds.evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part 2 (S2E4, running #14): Beast: 'This is no temple, but the mighty spacecraft Ship... a weapon of Apocalypse'; the X-Men fight to stop Nur entering the shrine; 'I was able to use pieces from Ship to repair the time-bands.' Wikipedia: Beast uses parts of Ship to create a time travel device.

adds.title: X-Men '97#19
adds.text: Warren storms X-Corp with X-Force to get at Apocalypse in Gambit's body, and Apocalypse seizes control of him with every mutant there until Rogue frees them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Takes control of Warren at X-Corp.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Falls under Apocalypse's control at X-Corp.
adds.evidence: Survival of the Fittest (S2E9, running #19): X-Force (Cable, Psylocke, Archangel) and X-Factor attack X-Corp for Gambit's body; Apocalypse brainwashes all of the X-Men, X-Force and X-Factor ('For now, you all belong to me'); Rogue frees Gambit and the others.
